lines.japanese:
犬の遠吠えはまだ続いている。
　このままじゃはっきりいって眠れない。
　……眠れないけど、まあ、それは常人の神経のレヴェルの話だ。
「………………眠いので、パス」
　シーツをかぶって、ベッドに横になる。
　犬の遠吠えなんて、道を走る自動車の音だと思えばいい。
lines.label: s203
lines.maoEnglish: The dogs are still howling. Frankly, nobody could sleep through this. Nobody with ordinary nerves, anyway. “I’m too tired. Not my problem.” I pull the sheet over myself and lie back down. I only have to pretend the howling is traffic passing on the road.
lines.mao_english: The dogs are still howling. Frankly, nobody could sleep through this. Nobody with ordinary nerves, anyway. “I’m too tired. Not my problem.” I pull the sheet over myself and lie back down. I only have to pretend the howling is traffic passing on the road.
lines.mirrorMoon:
The howling continues.
There's no way I can sleep like this.
…… I can't sleep, but that's just normal.
"……………… I'm sleepy, so I'll pass."
Pulling the sheets over me, I stretch out on the bed.
I can just think of the howling as the sound of something mundane, like cars driving by on the street.

mirrorMoonErrors.reason: Shiki wryly says that being unable to sleep through the howling is a limitation at the level of an ordinary person's nerves—implying that he can simply ignore it. 'That's just normal' does not express that contrast and makes the immediate decision to sleep appear contradictory.

lines.japanese:
「………はあ」
　今日はなんだか長い一日だった。
　慣れない屋敷での夕食や秋葉たちとの会話で精神も疲れきっている。
その前には犬の遠吠えなんて、ただの雑音に他ならない。
　目を閉じてしまえば、あとはゆるやかに眠りの中へと落ちていけた。
lines.label: s203
lines.maoEnglish: “Haa…” It has been a long day. Dinner in an unfamiliar mansion and talking with Akiha and the others have exhausted me so thoroughly that the howling is nothing but background noise. Once I close my eyes, sleep takes me gently down.
lines.mao_english: “Haa…” It has been a long day. Dinner in an unfamiliar mansion and talking with Akiha and the others have exhausted me so thoroughly that the howling is nothing but background noise. Once I close my eyes, sleep takes me gently down.
lines.mirrorMoon:
*sigh*
Today's been a very long day.
I'm mentally tired from eating dinner in this unfamiliar mansion and my conversations with Akiha and everyone else.
After all that, the howling is just background noise.
I close my eyes and gently fall asleep.

lines.japanese:
「――――ん」
　なにか、物音が聞こえた気がした。
　ねぼけまなこで時計を見てみると、時刻は午前二時になったばかりだ。
　……さっきの野犬の騒ぎから、二時間ほど経っている。
　野犬の鳴き声はとっくにやんでいた。
　屋敷の夜は時計の秒針の音が響くぐらい、静かだ。
lines.label: s203
lines.maoEnglish: “Mm…?” I think I hear something. Peering blearily at the clock, I see that it has just turned two in the morning. About two hours have passed since the commotion with the stray dogs. Their barking stopped long ago. The mansion at night is so still that even the ticking clock carries through it.
lines.mao_english: “Mm…?” I think I hear something. Peering blearily at the clock, I see that it has just turned two in the morning. About two hours have passed since the commotion with the stray dogs. Their barking stopped long ago. The mansion at night is so still that even the ticking clock carries through it.
lines.mirrorMoon:
"----Nng."
I think I just heard something.
Half-awake, I look at the clock.
It's just past two.
…… It's been about two hours since I heard the dogs howling.
The dogs' howling has already stopped.
The mansion is so quiet, I can hear the clock ticking in the silence.

lines.japanese:
「――――――？」
　また物音が聞こえた。
　……屋敷の中……ロビーのほうだろうか。
「―――――まさか、泥棒？」
　ありえない話じゃない。
　この屋敷は金目のものでしか構成されていないとんでもない屋敷だ。
くわえて、今は俺と秋葉、琥珀さんと翡翠しかいないっていう無用心ぶりである。
「……………」
　ベッドから出て、足音を立てないように部屋を出る。
lines.label: s203
lines.maoEnglish: “…?” There it is again. Somewhere inside the mansion—perhaps near the foyer. “A burglar…?” It isn’t impossible. The whole absurd mansion seems to be made of valuables, and at present only Akiha, Kohaku, Hisui, and I are here. “…” I slip out of bed and leave the room without making a sound.
lines.mao_english: “…?” There it is again. Somewhere inside the mansion—perhaps near the foyer. “A burglar…?” It isn’t impossible. The whole absurd mansion seems to be made of valuables, and at present only Akiha, Kohaku, Hisui, and I are here. “…” I slip out of bed and leave the room without making a sound.
lines.mirrorMoon:
"------?"
I hear it again.
…… Inside the mansion…… from the lobby?
"-----Could it be a burglar?"
It's not impossible.
The mansion's contents are outrageously valuable.
On top of that, with no one here now except Kohaku-san, Hisui, Akiha and myself, it's very insecure.
"……………"
I get out of bed, and slip out of the room quietly.

lines.japanese:
……もし泥棒だったら秋葉たちが危ないし、こればっかりは見過ごしておけない。
　二階からロビーの様子を眺めるだけなら、こっちにも危険はないと思う。
lines.label: s203
lines.maoEnglish: If it is a burglar, Akiha and the others could be in danger. I can’t ignore that. There should be no risk in merely looking down into the foyer from the second floor.
lines.mao_english: If it is a burglar, Akiha and the others could be in danger. I can’t ignore that. There should be no risk in merely looking down into the foyer from the second floor.
lines.mirrorMoon:
…… If it's a burglar, Akiha and everyone will be in danger, so I can't let this one go.
I'll just look down from the second floor into the lobby; that should be safe enough.
lines.mirror_moon:
…… If it's a burglar, Akiha and everyone will be in danger, so I can't let this one go.

lines.japanese:
……ロビーには異状はない。
「……………！」
　いや、誰かいる。
　玄関から入ってきて、ふらふらとおぼつかない足取りでロビーを横切っていく姿は―――
「あき……は？」
　秋葉は二階の自分の部屋にではなく、一階の西館へ歩いていく。
　その先にあるものは琥珀さんの部屋と、親父の部屋ぐらいのものだ。
lines.label: s203
lines.maoEnglish:
Nothing seems amiss in the foyer.
“…!” No—someone is there. A figure has entered through the front door and is tottering unsteadily across the foyer—
“Aki… ha?” Instead of going upstairs to her room, Akiha heads into the west wing on the ground floor. There is little that way except Kohaku’s room and Father’s.
lines.mao_english:
Nothing seems amiss in the foyer.
“…!” No—someone is there. A figure has entered through the front door and is tottering unsteadily across the foyer—
“Aki… ha?” Instead of going upstairs to her room, Akiha heads into the west wing on the ground floor. There is little that way except Kohaku’s room and Father’s.
lines.mirrorMoon:
There's nothing wrong there.
"……………!"
No, someone's there.
The figure that enters from the entrance and crosses the lobby with wobbling, uncertain steps, is---
"Aki…… ha?"
She's not going to her own room on the second floor, but to the first floor of the west wing.
The only things there are Kohaku-san's room and my old man's room.

lines.japanese:
「……なにしてたんだ、アイツ。
こんな夜更けに……」
　呟いてみても答えはない。
　しばらくロビーの様子を眺めてから、大人しく自分の部屋に戻ることにした。
lines.label: s203
lines.maoEnglish: “What was she doing out this late…?” The empty foyer offers no answer. After watching a little longer, I quietly return to my room.
lines.mao_english: “What was she doing out this late…?” The empty foyer offers no answer. After watching a little longer, I quietly return to my room.
lines.mirrorMoon:
"…… What's she doing at this time of night……?"
I can murmur all I want, but there won't be any answers forthcoming.
After gazing at the lobby for a while, I decide to return to my room.
lines.mirror_moon:
"…… What's she doing at this time of night……?"

lines.japanese:
……まあ、何か用事があったのか、それとも琥珀さんに会いにいったのかもしれない。
　こっちもこっそり盗み見ていたという負い目もあるし、あれこれ詮索するのも気が引ける。
「……寝よ寝よ。
明日も学校だ」
　ベッドにもぐりこんで、目を閉じる。
―――眠りに落ちる途中。
　ロビーで見かけた、うつろな瞳をした秋葉の姿が、なにかよくない物のように、何度も何度も思い返されていた。
lines.label: s203
lines.maoEnglish:
Perhaps she had some business there, or perhaps she went to see Kohaku. I already feel guilty for spying on her, so prying any further would be wrong. “Back to bed. I’ve got school tomorrow.” I crawl beneath the covers and close my eyes.
As sleep closes over me—
I see Akiha as she was in the foyer, her eyes empty. Like an omen, the image returns to me again and again.
lines.mao_english:
Perhaps she had some business there, or perhaps she went to see Kohaku. I already feel guilty for spying on her, so prying any further would be wrong. “Back to bed. I’ve got school tomorrow.” I crawl beneath the covers and close my eyes.
As sleep closes over me—
I see Akiha as she was in the foyer, her eyes empty. Like an omen, the image returns to me again and again.
lines.mirrorMoon:
……… Well, she probably had something to do, or went to see Kohaku-san.
I feel bad about sneaking around and watching her, and I don't want to just ask her about everything she does.
"…… Sleep, sleep.
There's school tomorrow."
I bury myself in bed and close my eyes.
---As I fall asleep,
my thoughts keep returning over and over to Akiha's hollow-eyed figure in the lobby, and how something seemed wrong.

lines.japanese:
……何の根拠もない。
　なのに、ただ漠然と、あの人なら俺の悩みを解決してくれるかもしれないと思った。
「―――――」
　迷っている暇はない。
　自分一人でこんなモノを抱えることには、これ以上耐えられない。
「悪い、先に戻っていてくれ有彦！」
「ああ？
　先に戻ってろって、どこ行くんだよ遠野！」
lines.label: s415
lines.maoEnglish:
There is no reason to believe it. Even so, I have the vague conviction that she might be able to resolve what is tormenting me.
“…” There is no time to hesitate. I can’t bear carrying this thing alone any longer. “Sorry, Arihiko—go on back without me!”
“Huh? Go back where? Where the hell are you going, Tohno?”

“Huh? Go back where? Where the hell are you going, Tohno?”
lines.mirrorMoon:
…… I don't have any reason for it.
But I just have a vague feeling she might be the person able to help me with my troubles.
"-----"
There's no time to think.
I can't bear to keep this to myself any longer.
"Sorry, you go on ahead, Arihiko!"
"Huh?
'Go on ahead'?
Where are you going, Tohno!?"

　五時限目はとっくに始まってしまっている。
lines.label: s415
lines.maoEnglish: I have practically dragged Ciel behind the school with enough force to deserve a scolding. Fifth period is already well under way.
lines.mao_english: I have practically dragged Ciel behind the school with enough force to deserve a scolding. Fifth period is already well under way.
lines.mirrorMoon:
…… Anyway, I get her to come to the rear of the school building so forcefully that it can't be helped if she gets mad at me.
Fifth period has already started.
lines.mirror_moon:

lines.japanese:
「もう、いきなりこんなところに連れて来て、なんなんですか遠野くん」
　……先輩は怒っているというより呆れている。
「ごめん先輩。
けど、さっきの話をもう少し詳しく聞きたいんだ」
「さっきの話って、通り魔殺人の話ですか？」
「そう。
その、罪を罪と感じないっていうヤツ。
それって、ようするに無自覚で人殺しをしているっていう事なのかな」
　……例えば。
　自分は眠っているつもりでも、外に出て人殺しをしてしまっている、といったふうな。
lines.label: s415
lines.maoEnglish: “Honestly, Tohno, what is this about? Dragging me out here without warning…” She sounds more exasperated than angry. “Sorry, Ciel. I need to hear more about what you said earlier.” “About the street murders?” “Yes. That part about not recognizing guilt as guilt. Does that mean the killer could be murdering people without knowing it?” For example, someone might believe he was asleep while actually wandering outside and killing people.

Does that mean the killer could be murdering people without knowing it?” For example, someone might believe he was asleep while actually wandering outside and killing people.
lines.mirrorMoon:
"Geez, pulling me to a place like this, what is it Tohno-kun?"
…… Senpai is more amazed than angry.
"I'm sorry, senpai.
But, I wanted to hear more about what you were saying before."
"What I was saying before… you mean the serial killer?"
"Yes, that.
About the person who doesn't feel a crime is a crime.
Are you saying they kill people unconsciously?"
…… For example.
Like intending to sleep but instead going outside to commit murder.

こっちは本当に大真面目なんだから」
「ええ、そうみたいですね。
だけどどうしたんです？
　通り魔事件の犯人のことなんて、遠野くんには関係ないじゃないですか」
「それは――――」
lines.label: s415
lines.maoEnglish:
“I’m joking. You looked so desperately serious that I couldn’t resist teasing you.” “Please don’t. I really am serious.”
“Yes, I can see that. But what brought this on? The murderer has nothing to do with you.” “That’s…”

"That's----"

"Yes?
What is it?"
…… That's.
"If---if I told you I was the killer, what would you do?"
I finally say it.
But.
Senpai's face lights up as if I said the funniest joke, and she bursts into laughter.

lines.japanese:
「先輩、冗談じゃないんだ。
俺は―――」
「ええ、遠野くんが本気だっていうことは分かってます。
けど、だからなんだかおかしくて。
だって自分が殺人鬼なんだって相談にくる殺人鬼なんて、普通いないじゃないですか」
「先輩―――――」
「それじゃわたしから聞きますけど、遠野くんはなんだってそんなふうに思うんです？」
「それは―――その、最近の俺、おかしいんだ。
……原因は判ってる。
たぶん、俺は吸血鬼に噛まれたんだ」
　……何かの比喩のように、そう言った。
lines.label: s415
lines.maoEnglish:
“Ciel, this isn’t a joke. I—”
“I know you mean it. That’s what makes it funny. Murderers don’t ordinarily seek advice because they’re worried they might be murderers.” “Ciel…”
“Then let me ask you: why do you think such a thing?” “Because… I haven’t been myself lately. I know the cause. I think a vampire bit me.” I say it as if it were some kind of metaphor.
lines.mao_english:
“Ciel, this isn’t a joke. I—”
“I know you mean it. That’s what makes it funny. Murderers don’t ordinarily seek advice because they’re worried they might be murderers.” “Ciel…”
“Then let me ask you: why do you think such a thing?” “Because… I haven’t been myself lately. I know the cause. I think a vampire bit me.” I say it as if it were some kind of metaphor.
lines.mirrorMoon:
"Senpai, this is no joke, I'm---"
"Yes, I know you're serious.
But that's why it's funny.
Because the murderer doesn't usually come and ask for help because they're the murderer."
"Senpai-----"
"Then I will ask.
Why do you think so, Tohno-kun?"
"It's because---recently, I've been… strange.
I know why.
I was probably bitten by a vampire."
…… I say it frankly, as if it was a euphemism.

lines.japanese:
「―――どうぞ。
まだ続きがあるんでしょう？」
「……それ以来、なんかヘンなんだ。
突然自分が自分じゃないみたいになったり、人を殺してしまう夢を見たりする。
　昨日なんて、俺は眠っているつもりだったのに外に出歩いていたらしいんだ。
……その時見ていた夢も人を殺して、血を吸う夢だった」
「――――――」
　先輩は何も言わず、ただ俺の目を見ている。
lines.label: s415
lines.maoEnglish: “Go on. There is more, isn’t there?” “Ever since then, something has been wrong with me. Sometimes I suddenly feel like someone else. I dream about killing people. Yesterday, I thought I was asleep, but apparently I went wandering outside. And in the dream I was having then, I killed someone and drank their blood.” “…” Ciel says nothing. She only studies my eyes.

lines.mirrorMoon:
"---Please, go on."
"…… Since then, it's been strange.
Suddenly I don't feel like myself, and I have dreams about killing people.
Last night, although I only intended to sleep, it seems that I went out.
And I had a dream in which I killed someone, and sucked blood."
"------"
Senpai says nothing, just watching me.

lines.japanese:
「……俺の親父は二重人格だったそうだし、もしかしすると俺本人が気がついていないだけで、人殺しの俺がいるのかもしれない。
でもそれを確かめるコトができなくて、俺は―――」
「それで遠野くんは犯人は無自覚なのか、なんて聞いてきたんですね」
　はあ、と先輩は呆れた。
lines.label: s415
lines.maoEnglish:
“They say my father had two personalities. Maybe there’s a murderer inside me and I’m simply the one who doesn’t know. But I have no way to find out, and I…”
“So that is why you asked whether the killer might be unaware.” Ciel sighs in exasperation.

lines.mirrorMoon:
"…… My father had a split personality.
Maybe I just don't know about it, but there might be a killer in me.
But I have no way of finding out---"
"So that's why you came to ask if the killer was unconscious of his actions."
Senpai sighs in amazement.

lines.japanese:
「あのですね、もし遠野くんがその殺人鬼さんだとしたら、無自覚なんかじゃありませんよ。
夢として殺人の行為を見ている時点で、それは無自覚ではありませんから。
　けど、そんなことよりですね。
はっきり言ってしまうと、そんなのはただの夢です。
遠野くんがなにを不安がってるかは知りませんけど、遠野くんは遠野くんです」
「―――――」
　……そう言ってくれるのは、嬉しいけど。
　俺には先輩の言葉を鵜呑みできるものが、何一つだってありはしない。
lines.label: s415
lines.maoEnglish:
“Listen. If you were the killer, you wouldn’t be unaware of it. The moment you witness the murders in your dreams, they are part of your awareness. More importantly, they are only dreams. I don’t know what has frightened you so badly, but you are still you, Tohno.”
“…” I’m grateful to hear it. But I have no reason—none at all—to accept her reassurance on faith.

“…” I’m grateful to hear it. But I have no reason—none at all—to accept her reassurance on faith.
lines.mirrorMoon:
"Um, if you were truly the killer, you would not be unconscious of yourself.
The point you're seeing it in your dreams makes it not unconscious.
But more importantly, it's just a dream.
I don't know what you're worried about, but Tohno-kun is Tohno-kun."
"-----"
…… I'm glad to hear that, but…
There's no reason for me to believe in any of Senpai's words.

「はあ。
よっぽど不安なんですね、遠野くん」
　言って。
　先輩はぽんぽん、と俺の頭をなでた。
lines.label: s415

“My. You really are frightened, aren’t you, Tohno?”
With that, Ciel pats me lightly on the head.

"You must be feeling really uneasy, Tohno-kun."
With that,
Senpai pats my head.

lines.japanese:
「―――大丈夫ですよ。
遠野くんは何の問題もありません。
他でもないわたしが保証するんですから、絶対に大丈夫です」
「あ――――はい」
　……自然に、心からうなずいていた。
　ただこうしている間だけだって分かっていても、心が休まる。
　こっちの不安を包み込むような、先輩の手の平が優しかった。
lines.label: s415
lines.maoEnglish: “You’ll be all right. There is nothing wrong with you. I am personally guaranteeing it, so you are absolutely going to be all right.” “Oh… okay.” The nod comes naturally, from somewhere deep inside me. Even knowing the relief will last only as long as this moment, I can finally breathe. Her palm is gentle, as though it could cradle every fear I have.

"---It's okay.
You have nothing to worry about, Tohno-kun.
I myself guarantee it, so it's definitely okay."
"Ah----okay."
…… Automatically, I nod in complete agreement.
Even if I know it's only while she's doing so, I feel at ease.
Like wrapping up my uneasiness, Senpai's hands are gentle.

lines.japanese:
放課後になった。
　秋葉の事や自分の事で混乱しながら、とりあえず一日が終わろうとしている。
「……帰るか」
　秋葉を迎えにいって、屋敷に帰ろう。
lines.label: s415
lines.maoEnglish:
School lets out. Though my thoughts remain tangled around Akiha and myself, the day is finally drawing to a close.
“Time to go.” I’ll collect Akiha, and we’ll head home.
lines.mao_english:

lines.mirrorMoon:
School is over now.
I was confused about myself and Akiha, but today is about to end.
"…… Time to go home."
I should go get Akiha and go back to our mansion.

lines.japanese:
秋葉と一緒に帰路につく。
　……昼休みの時と同じように、二人きりになるとお互い会話が途絶えてしまった。
―――秋葉と話したいと思う反面、秋葉の顔を見るのが照れくさい。
「……まったく、中学生じゃあるまいし」
「……？
　何か言いましたか、兄さん？」
「あ―――いや、なんでもない。
ただの独り言」
　……はあ。
　ほんと、一体何をしているんだろう遠野志貴は。
lines.label: s415
lines.maoEnglish:
Akiha and I start home together. Just as at lunch, the moment we are alone, conversation deserts us both.
I want to talk to her, yet somehow I’m too self-conscious even to look at her face.
“Honestly. I’m not a middle-schooler anymore.”
“Hm? Did you say something, Brother?” “Oh—no. Just talking to myself.”
God. What are you doing, Shiki Tohno?

lines.mirrorMoon:
I walk home together with Akiha.
…… Just like lunchtime, we grow quiet as soon as there are only the two of us.
---While I want to talk to Akiha, I also feel embarrassed looking at Akiha.
"…… Man, it's not like I'm a middle schooler."
"…?
Did you say something Nii-san?"
"Oh---no, it's nothing, just talking to myself."
…… *sigh*
Really, what the hell am I doing?

lines.japanese:
長い坂道につく。
　ここを登りきれば屋敷は目の前だ。
「兄さん。
屋敷に戻る前に、一つお聞きしたい事があります」
　ぴたり、と足を止めて、秋葉はまっすぐに俺を見据えてきた。
「―――――」
　そこにはさっきまでの、じれったいような沈黙はない。
　秋葉は真剣な眼差しで俺を見ている。
lines.label: s415
lines.maoEnglish:
We reach the long slope. Once we climb it, the mansion will be directly ahead.
“Brother. Before we return to the mansion, there is one thing I wish to ask you.” Akiha stops dead and faces me squarely. “…” The awkward silence from before is gone. Her gaze is grave and unwavering.

lines.mirrorMoon:
We reach the long hill.
Once we go up it, our mansion will be right there.
"Nii-san.
I would like to ask you one thing before we get home."
Akiha's feet stop and she looks straight at me.
"-----"
The kind of silence that was there before is gone.
Akiha looks at me seriously.

lines.japanese:
「いいよ。
聞きたい事ってなに？」
「……その、以前も聞きましたけど、兄さんはシエルをどう思っているんですか？」
「――――なんだ、なにかと思ったらまたそれか。
どう思ってるかも何も、先輩は先輩だよ。
なんでも相談できる頼りがいのある先輩だけど」
「……そうですね。
兄さんはなにか悩みごとがあるようでしたから。
今日の朝のことも、それが原因だったんでしょう？」
「―――――」
　……驚いた。
　秋葉は、俺が一人で悩んでいたことに気付いてたのか。
lines.label: s415
lines.maoEnglish:
“Sure. What do you want to ask?”
“I asked you once before, but… how do you feel about Ciel?” “That again? Ciel is Ciel. She’s a dependable upperclassman I can talk to about anything.”
“Yes, I suppose she is. You seemed troubled about something. That was also the reason for what happened this morning, wasn’t it?” “…” I’m taken aback. Akiha noticed that I’d been worrying alone.

"Go ahead, what do you wanna ask about?"

I don't think anything of her.

"…… I see.
It seemed like something was bothering you; this morning was a result of it too, wasn't it?"
"-----"
…… I'm surprised.
Akiha knew that I was worrying about the problem by myself.

lines.maoEnglish:
“Akiha… you knew?”
“Of course. We are brother and sister. I can at least tell when you are miserable. And yet why wouldn’t you confide in me? Do you trust that woman more than your own sister?” “Y-you saw me talking to Ciel…?”

兄さん、あの人の前ではすごく素直なんですから！」

lines.maoEnglish:
“I did. I could hardly believe my eyes. You’re so open with her!”
Akiha turns away with an offended huff. “That isn’t it. I didn’t tell you or Kohaku because…” Because I couldn’t bear for them to learn what my body had become and hate me for it.

I didn't talk to you or Kohaku-san, because---"

“I don’t want to hear your excuses.”

lines.label: s415
lines.maoEnglish: “Then I shall speak plainly. You and that woman are ill-suited to one another. Do not grow any closer to her. It will bring you nothing good.” “What—” The words come so abruptly that they silence me.
lines.mao_english: “Then I shall speak plainly. You and that woman are ill-suited to one another. Do not grow any closer to her. It will bring you nothing good.” “What—” The words come so abruptly that they silence me.
lines.mirrorMoon:
"Fine, I'll come out and say it.
That person doesn't suit you.
So please, do not get any closer to her.
It is for your sake."
"Wha----"
It's so sudden I'm at a loss for words.

lines.japanese:
「秋葉。
それは、一般家庭の人間は遠野家には相応しくないっていう意味で言ってるのか」
「………………」
　秋葉は答えない。
　沈黙は、すなわちイエスだ。
lines.label: s415
lines.maoEnglish: “Akiha. Are you saying someone from an ordinary family isn’t good enough for a Tohno?” “…” She does not answer. Her silence means yes.
lines.mao_english: “Akiha. Are you saying someone from an ordinary family isn’t good enough for a Tohno?” “…” She does not answer. Her silence means yes.
lines.mirrorMoon:
"Akiha.
Are you saying that ordinary people are not suitable company for those of the Tohno house, then?"
"…………"
Akiha doesn't answer.
The silence means a yes.
lines.mirror_moon:
"Akiha.

"…………"

lines.japanese:
「───そうか。
そうだよな、そりゃあ秋葉は遠野家の当主だもんな。
親父と同じで家柄や血筋が大事だっていうんだろ？」
「……兄さん、それは」
「いいよ、別に文句を言ってるわけじゃない。
秋葉を一人残して家を出たのは俺のほうだ。
本来ならさ、そういうふうに育てられたのは俺の方だったんだ。
だから、秋葉を悪く言ってるんじゃないんだ」
「…………………」
「でもな、今のは聞き流せない。
先輩のことを何もしらないクセに、相応しくないなんて、そんなコト言わないでくれ」
lines.label: s415
lines.maoEnglish:
“I see. Of course. You’re the head of the Tohno family, after all. Just like Father, you care about pedigree and bloodlines, is that it?”
“Brother, that isn’t—” “It’s fine. I’m not criticizing you. I’m the one who left you alone and walked away from this family. I was the one who should have been raised that way. So I’m not blaming you.”
“…” “But I can’t let what you just said pass. You know nothing about Ciel, so don’t say she isn’t good enough.”

“…” “But I can’t let what you just said pass. You know nothing about Ciel, so don’t say she isn’t good enough.”
lines.mirrorMoon:

So, I'm not speaking badly of you."

"But, I can't let what you said right now go.
Even though you don't know anything about Senpai, don't just say she's unsuitable."

秋葉はうつむいたままで何も言わない。
　しばらく、俺たちの間に言葉はなかった。
「…………のクセに」
「え───？」
「兄さんだって遠野家の事を何も知らないクセに、勝手な事を言わないで――！」
　苦しげに叫んで、秋葉は俺の前から離れた。
lines.label: s415
lines.maoEnglish:
Akiha remains bowed and silent. For a while, neither of us speaks.
“…when you don’t know anything either.” “What…?”
“You don’t know anything about the Tohno family either, Brother, so stop saying whatever you please!” The cry tears out of her in pain, and she recoils from me.
lines.mao_english:

“…when you don’t know anything either.” “What…?”
“You don’t know anything about the Tohno family either, Brother, so stop saying whatever you please!” The cry tears out of her in pain, and she recoils from me.
lines.mirrorMoon:
Looking down, Akiha says nothing.
For a while, we stand in silence.
"…… You don't…"
"Eh---?"
"Nii-san, You don't know anything about the Tohno house, don't say such selfish things!"
Crying out painfully, Akiha pulls away from me.

lines.japanese:
「───とにかく、あの人とは親しくしないで。
あの人は違う人です。
親しくすればするほど、兄さんが苦しくなるだけだわ」
　秋葉は坂道を駆け上がっていく。
「───なんだよ、それ」
　俺は呆然と、秋葉の後ろ姿を見つめることしかできなかった。
lines.label: s415
lines.maoEnglish:
“In any case, stay away from that woman. She is not what you think. The closer you become, the more you will suffer.”
Akiha runs up the hill.
“What the hell does that mean…?” All I can do is stare numbly after her.
lines.mao_english:

lines.mirrorMoon:
"---Anyway, you mustn't get close to that person.
She's not like us.
If you get any closer to her, you're the one who would suffer."
Akiha runs up the hill.
"---What does that mean?"
All I can do is gaze up after her, aghast.

lines.japanese:
屋敷に戻ってきた。
　いつもなら何も考えずにロビーに入るのだが、今は中に入りづらい。
　……この屋敷に戻ってきて、俺はさんざん秋葉を怒らせてきたと思う。
　けど、さっきのは本物だ。
　俺は初めて、秋葉を本気で怒らせて、あんな苦しそうな声をあげさせてしまった。
lines.label: s415
lines.maoEnglish: I arrive at the mansion. Usually I would walk straight into the foyer without thinking, but now I can’t bring myself to enter. Since returning, I must have angered Akiha countless times. But that was different. For the first time, I truly hurt her—hurt her enough to make her cry out like that.
lines.mao_english: I arrive at the mansion. Usually I would walk straight into the foyer without thinking, but now I can’t bring myself to enter. Since returning, I must have angered Akiha countless times. But that was different. For the first time, I truly hurt her—hurt her enough to make her cry out like that.
lines.mirrorMoon:
I return to the mansion.
Though I usually go into the lobby without thinking, right now it's hard to enter.
…… I have made Akiha angry many times since I came back to the mansion.
But, she was really mad back then.
For the first time, I really angered Akiha, and made her sound so hurt.

「………………」
　さっきのはどっちが悪い、という問題じゃないと思う。
　ちゃんと時間が経てば秋葉も冷静になって、どうしてシエル先輩をあんなに嫌うのかを説明してくれるはずだ。
「……庭でも回るか」
　屋敷の中に入ると秋葉と顔を合わせるかもしれないし、しばらく庭を散歩しよう。
lines.label: s415
lines.maoEnglish:
“…” I don’t think what happened can be reduced to which of us was wrong. Once enough time passes, Akiha will calm down and explain why she hates Ciel so much.
“Maybe I’ll walk around the garden.” If I go inside, I may run into Akiha. Better to stay out here for a while.

「あれ、琥珀さん……？」
　そこにいたのは琥珀さんだった。
　……こっちには気がついていないみたいだけど、林のほうへ行こうとしている。
　琥珀さんはこちらに気づいていない。
　何をしにいくんだろう、琥珀さんは森の中に入っていく。
「？」
　興味をひかれて、少しだけ後についていった。
lines.label: s415
lines.maoEnglish:
“Oh, Kohaku…?” It is Kohaku. She doesn’t seem to have noticed me, and she is heading toward the trees.
Still unaware of me, Kohaku enters the woods. What could she be doing in there? Curious, I follow her a little way.

lines.japanese:
琥珀さんが歩いていった先には、ちょっとした広場があるようだった。
「……？
　あんなところに広場なんて……」
　首をかしげて思い出そうとしてみるが、どうも記憶はあいまいだ。
　屋敷の森の中、木々をきりとったような広場が見える。
lines.label: s415
lines.maoEnglish: Beyond the path Kohaku took lies a small clearing. “Was there always a clearing back here…?” I tilt my head and search my memory, but find only haze. There it is among the mansion woods, as if someone has cut a hole from the trees.
lines.mao_english: Beyond the path Kohaku took lies a small clearing. “Was there always a clearing back here…?” I tilt my head and search my memory, but find only haze. There it is among the mansion woods, as if someone has cut a hole from the trees.
lines.mirrorMoon:
It seems there's a small clearing where Kohaku-san headed to.
"……… There's a clearing there……?"
Tilting my head to the side, I try to remember, but for some reason, my memory is a bit vague.
In the forest of the mansion, I can see a clearing as if the trees were cut there.

――――いや、見えるというのは正しくない。
　普通に歩いている分には決して見えなかったはずだ。
　琥珀さんがあそこに歩いて行かなければ、屋敷に住んでいながら一生気づかなかったぐらい隠れた、木々に囲まれた小さな広場。
lines.label: s415
lines.maoEnglish:
No. Saying that I can see it isn’t quite right.
No ordinary path would ever have revealed it. If Kohaku had not walked there, I might have lived in the mansion my entire life without discovering that tiny clearing enclosed by trees.

――――ない、ような、気が、する。
「…………」
　少しだけ思案してから、その広場に入ってみることにした。
lines.label: s415
lines.maoEnglish:
“Was that always there…? If it was, we would have loved playing in it…” At least, I have no memory of playing with Akiha in any forest clearing.
I don’t… think… I do.
“…” After considering it for a moment, I step into the clearing.

lines.label: s415
lines.maoEnglish:

“Oh. It’s only an empty lot.”
I walk to its center. It truly is nothing more than vacant ground: earth leveled smooth and flat, surrounded by the trees of the deep wood.

lines.japanese:
「志貴さま、朝です。
お目覚めください」
　……聞きなれた声がする。
「志貴さま……どうかお目覚めください。
昨日に引き続き遅刻をなされると、秋葉さまとのお約束を破ることになってしまいます」
　……切迫しているのか落ち着いているのか、なかなかに判別がつきにくい声がする。
lines.label: s503
lines.maoEnglish:
“Master Shiki, it is morning. Please wake up.”
A familiar voice reaches me.
“Master Shiki… please wake up. If you are late again today, you will break your promise to Miss Akiha.”
The voice is somehow too composed to sound urgent and too urgent to sound composed.

…… A voice partly tense, partly relaxed.

lines.japanese:
「志貴さま。
よろしいのですね、今朝も秋葉さまにお叱りをうけるということで」
　……そんなの、よろしいハズがない。
「……起きる。
起きるから、ちょっと待って」
　シーツをかぶったままその返答をして、ゆっくりと目を覚ますことにした。
lines.label: s503
lines.maoEnglish:
“Master Shiki. Am I to understand that you wish to be scolded by Miss Akiha again this morning?”
No. I most certainly do not.
“I’m getting up. Just give me a minute.” Still hidden under the sheet, I answer and slowly begin the business of waking.

Akiha-sama will end up scolding you again."

"…… I'm up.
I'm up, so hold on."
Still under the sheets, I respond as I slowly open my eyes.

「おはようございます、志貴さま」
「あい、おはよう」
　ねぼけた頭で挨拶を返して、メガネをかける。
　時刻は朝の七時すぎ。
　いつも通りの時間に翡翠が起こしにきて、めずらしく目を覚ました自分がいる。
「それでは朝食の支度をいたします。
着替えがすみしだい、食堂にいらしてください」
　一礼をして、翡翠は部屋から立ち去っていった。
lines.label: s503
lines.maoEnglish:
“Good morning, Master Shiki.” “Mornin’.” I return the greeting through a fog of sleep and put on my glasses. It is a little after seven. Hisui has come to wake me at the usual time, and, unusually, I have actually woken up.
“I shall prepare breakfast. Please come to the dining room once you have dressed.”
Hisui bows and leaves the room.

lines.japanese:
秋葉との関係は、多少、なんとなく気まずいものがあるものの、やっぱり兄と妹なわけで。
　学校のほうは渡り廊下を修理中という事を除けば以前と何一つ変わっていない。
　……いや、変わったか。
　学校には、シエルなんていう名前の先輩はどこにもいないし、誰も覚えてさえいない。
　街を騒がしていた通り魔事件もあれから一件だって起きていない。
犯人が捕まったわけではないので相変わらず夜の街は寂しいけれど、あと一ヶ月もすればもとの夜に戻るだろう。
lines.label: s503
lines.maoEnglish:
Things with Akiha are a little awkward in some indefinable way, but we are still brother and sister. At school, nothing has changed except that the covered walkway is being repaired.
No—that isn’t true. There is no upperclassman named Ciel anywhere at school, and no one even remembers her. Nor has there been a single new attack in the string of murders that terrorized the city. The culprit was never caught, so the streets remain deserted at night, but in another month they will probably be back to normal.

The fifth period is about battles with vampires.
I have brought Professor Roa as a special guest.
Professor Roa, what is the reason for Tohno-kun's loss this time?
"I have to say he was a bit careless.
Finding out about your enemy's weapon is the top priority in a battle against the transcendent race.
Well, in this case, I think that he knew about it but, didn't act very intelligently."

lines.japanese:
ははあ。
　ところで博士。
どうして博士とこっちのシキさんは容姿が違うんですか？
　わたし、ずっと疑問に思ってたんですけど。
「そうですね、趣味の問題ではないでしょうか。
　シキの意識が薄かった時はかつてのロアとしての嗜好が表立ち、こういった服装や髪型をしていましたが。
　シキ君の方では、とある理由によってシキ君の自我がほぼ完全に崩壊してしまっているので、人格を寄り代にするロアも表立って出現できなかった、というコトではないか、と」
lines.label: s538
lines.maoEnglish:
I see. By the way, Doctor, why do you and this SHIKI look different? I’ve always wondered about that.
“A matter of taste, perhaps. When SHIKI’s consciousness was faint, Roa’s former preferences came to the surface, producing this manner of dress and hairstyle. In SHIKI’s case, however, his sense of self had almost entirely collapsed for certain reasons. Since Roa uses the host personality as his vessel, he could not manifest openly either—or so I would surmise.”
lines.mao_english:
I see. By the way, Doctor, why do you and this SHIKI look different? I’ve always wondered about that.
“A matter of taste, perhaps. When SHIKI’s consciousness was faint, Roa’s former preferences came to the surface, producing this manner of dress and hairstyle. In SHIKI’s case, however, his sense of self had almost entirely collapsed for certain reasons. Since Roa uses the host personality as his vessel, he could not manifest openly either—or so I would surmise.”
lines.mirrorMoon:
I see.
Excuse me, Professor, but why does SHIKI-san in this route look different than you?
I've been wondering about this for a long time.
"Yes, I think it's just a difference in tastes.
When SHIKI's mind was weak, Roa's preferences surfaced and I dressed like this.
But in this case, SHIKI-kun completely lost his mind for some reason, and Roa could not come out since he relies on taking control of someone's mind.
That is my theory on what happened."

lines.japanese:
秋葉・ノーマルエンディング、ごくろうさまでした。
　各ヒロインには（一名だけ例外がありますが）二種類のエンディングが用意されています。
　通常はトゥルーエンディングとグッドエンディングと呼ばれますが、秋葉さんだけはノーマルエンディング、トゥルーエンディングと呼ばれています。
　秋葉さんのルートは他のルートとは違っていて、好感度さえクリアしていればグッド・トゥルー、共に特別な条件を必要としません。
lines.label: s542
lines.maoEnglish:
Congratulations on completing Akiha’s Normal Ending.
Each heroine—with one exception—has two endings. Ordinarily they are called the True Ending and the Good Ending, but Akiha’s are instead called the Normal Ending and the True Ending.
Akiha’s route differs from the others: once you meet the affection requirement, neither ending has any additional special condition.
lines.mao_english:
Congratulations on completing Akiha’s Normal Ending.

Akiha’s route differs from the others: once you meet the affection requirement, neither ending has any additional special condition.

ニュースは、例の連続殺人事件の特番だった。
　事件が始まってからじき一ヶ月ほど経過するというのに犯人像はまったく浮かび上がっていない。
　痕跡も動機もいっさいなし、という正体不明の殺人鬼。
　こんな狭い街だけで犠牲者が八人も出ているのにいまだ正体不明というのは、さすがにゾッとする、とニュースキャスターが喋っていた。

lines.maoEnglish: Today it is airing a special on the serial murders. Nearly a month has passed since they began, yet the police still have no picture of the culprit. Eight people have died in this one small city, and the newsreader remarks that the killer’s continued anonymity is genuinely chilling.
lines.mirrorMoon:
The news is having a special feature on the serial killings.
It's been a whole month since the killings started, but no one yet has any idea who this killer is.
He is an unidentified killer, leaving no trace and acting with no motive.
His identity still remains a mystery, even though there has already been eight killings in our little town alone.
It's certainly very frightening, says the newscaster.
